                "font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md,13px)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums!important;",
                "font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Consolas,monospace!important;letter-spacing:.5px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-row{display:flex!important;gap:10px!important;margin-top:12px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-row .csh-dbg-btn{flex:1 1 0!important;min-height:44px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-hist{display:block!important;margin-top:12px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-sub{display:block!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-micro2,10.5px)!important;color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;",
                "font-weight:600!important;letter-spacing:.09em!important;margin-bottom:7px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-histrow{display:block!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-sm,12px)!important;color:var(--csh-gray)!important;",
                "font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums!important;padding:6px 0!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.06)!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-histrow:last-child{border-bottom:none!important;}",
                /* 手机短视口/窄屏：兑换框紧凑化 + 收窄码字字号——
                   30+ 字符长码在 15px 宽字距下超出输入框宽度，尾部永远看不见（2026-09-30 手机反馈） */
                "@media (max-width:480px),(max-height:600px){",
                "#csh-redeem{padding:16px 16px 14px!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-title{margin-bottom:10px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-lg,14px)!important;}",
                "#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-mirror-in,#csh-redeem .csh-rdm-inp{font-size:var(--csh-lfs-sm,12px)!important;letter-spacing:.03em!important;}",
                "}",
                /* ---------- 其他扩展安装面板的规则已迁出主 CSS ----------
                   （2026-10-06）主 CSS（本函数）只在打开调试面板时注入，且其内容随代码版本——
                   若玩家没打开过调试面板（或注入的旧版本不含这些规则），面板会以裸 DOM 出现
                   （用户实机报告「点开是底部一条横幅」）。现改为 openExtStore 自带的
                   ensureExtStoreStyle() 独立注入（无依赖、幂等），见该函数。 */
                /* ---------- 内容区（body 本体规则见上方 §E.1 段） ---------- */
                /* 每个页签的内容都应包一层 .csh-dbg-page，桌面端才限宽居中 */
                ".csh-dbg-page{display:block!important;width:100%!important;position:static!important;}",
                /* 【2026-10-03 精炼】等宽网格：一份规则同时服务桌面与手机 ——
                   auto-fill + minmax(150px,1fr)：宽度自己算列数，**所有按钮同宽**、
                   行首行尾对齐、末行不会只剩一个孤零零的按钮，也不必再写断点媒体查询。 */
                ".csh-dbg-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr))!important;gap:10px!important;width:100%!important;align-items:stretch!important;}",
                /* 顶层功能组＝白卡：给内容区建立「标签在上 / 控件成卡」的结构层次。
                   只吃 .csh-dbg-page 的直接子级——嵌在详情层、预设卡内部的 grid 保持无壳内联，
                   否则会出现卡中卡的套娃。 */
                "#csh-dbg-body .csh-dbg-page>.csh-dbg-grid{background:var(--csh-fg)!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.10)!important;border-radius:12px!important;padding:12px!important;",
                "box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.04),0 8px 24px -16px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.20)!important;}",
                /* 网格内的按钮一律撑满单元格（宽度由网格决定，按钮不再各行其是）。
                   grid-4 / grid-5 与基础网格同款 —— 保留类名只为兼容既有调用点。 */
                ".csh-dbg-grid>button,.csh-dbg-grid-4>button,.csh-dbg-grid-5>button{width:100%!important;text-align:center!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-grid-4,.csh-dbg-grid-5{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr))!important;gap:10px!important;width:100%!important;}",
                /* ---------- 按钮 ---------- */
                /* 【2026-10-01 触摸目标对齐】本项目其余交互件一律 44px：关闭键(1712) / 页签(1739) /
                   游戏卡开始键(1801) / 兑换行按钮(1855) / 壳各按钮(csh_shell 257·293·353)。
                   唯独 .csh-dbg-btn 是 padding:9px ⇒ 实测高 36px（<44），横跨 8 个页签共 60+ 个按钮。
                   padding 9→13px 使其达到 44px，与其同目录邻居保持一致。 */
                "button.csh-dbg-btn{display:inline-block!important;cursor:pointer!important;padding:13px 14px!important;min-height:44px!important;border-radius:10px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md,13px)!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;",
                "color:var(--csh-bg)!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.07),rgba(0,0,0,0) 62%),var(--csh-fg)!important;font-weight:500!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.26)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:1.25!important;margin:0!important;",
                "box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.03)!important;",
                "transition:border-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease,transform .16s ease,background .16s ease!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.60)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important;",
                "color:var(--csh-bg)!important;background:var(--csh-paper2)!important;box-shadow:0 3px 12px -4px rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.30)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn:active{transform:translateY(0)!important;}",
                /* 主按钮（确定/开始/兑换/读取）：CBY 黄实底 + 墨字（黄只作底，绝不作纸白上的文字，对比度 1.6:1 不可读） */
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.good{color:var(--csh-accent-ink)!important;border-color:var(--csh-accent)!important;background:var(--csh-accent)!important;font-weight:600!important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.38)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.good:hover{color:var(--csh-accent-ink)!important;border-color:var(--csh-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--csh-accent-dark)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px -4px rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.55)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.warn{color:var(--csh-red)!important;border-color:rgba(var(--csh-red-rgb),.45)!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.warn:hover{color:var(--csh-color-ink)!important;border-color:var(--csh-red)!important;background:var(--csh-red)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px -4px rgba(var(--csh-red-rgb),.45)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important;}",
                /* 【2026-10-03 精炼】语义色收敛：**实底只留给主操作**（.good / 危险 .warn）。
                   牌面/效果本身「有益 / 有害」这类语义改用**淡着色描边**（.pos / .neg）——
                   一整排金色实底块会跟真正的主操作抢注意力，视觉重量失衡。 */
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.pos{color:var(--csh-accent)!important;border-color:rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.42)!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.07)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.pos:hover{border-color:var(--csh-accent)!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.16)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.neg{color:var(--csh-red)!important;border-color:rgba(var(--csh-red-rgb),.38)!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-red-rgb),.06)!important;}",
                "button.csh-dbg-btn.neg:hover{border-color:var(--csh-red)!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-red-rgb),.16)!important;}",
                /* ---------- 说明条：统一一种样式，避免重复提示 ----------
                   【2026-10-03 精炼】原先每页都挂一条带金色粗左条的白底块，七页下来非常吵。
                   现在只保一根细左条（金 55%）+ 近透明底：**是提示，不是警报**。 */
                ".csh-dbg-hint{display:block!important;margin-top:12px!important;padding:9px 12px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap2,11.5px)!important;line-height:1.6!important;",
                "color:var(--csh-gray)!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.025)!important;border-radius:8px!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.05)!important;border-left:2px solid rgba(var(--csh-accent-rgb),.55)!important;}",
                /* ---------- 输入 ---------- */
                ".csh-dbg-row{display:block!important;width:100%!important;margin:0 0 9px!important;}",
                /* 目标 + 搜索同排；窄屏自动换行 */
                ".csh-dbg-tool{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:9px!important;width:100%!important;margin:0 0 8px!important;align-items:stretch!important;}",
                /* 【2026-09-30 空间修复】原 flex-basis 240 + input 220 + gap 9 = 469 > 手机可用 358px
                   ⇒ 工具行被迫换行，右侧留 118px 横向空洞并多占 51px 高度。
                   收紧到 150 / 170 后单行放下（329px），更窄的屏幕仍会正常换行。 */
                ".csh-dbg-tool select{flex:1 1 150px!important;min-width:0!important;display:block!important;padding:10px 12px!important;border-radius:8px!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.12)!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md,13px)!important;",
                "font-family:inherit!important;position:static!important;outline:none!important;transition:border-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-tool input{flex:1 1 170px!important;min-width:0!important;display:block!important;padding:13px 12px!important;min-height:44px!important;border-radius:8px!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.12)!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md,13px)!important;",
                "font-family:inherit!important;position:static!important;outline:none!important;transition:border-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-tool input::placeholder{color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-tool input:focus,.csh-dbg-tool select:focus{border-color:var(--csh-blue)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--csh-blue-rgb),.14)!important;}",
                /* 计数条：与输入区上下分离，避免与占位文字视觉重叠 */
                ".csh-dbg-count{display:block!important;width:100%!important;margin:0 0 8px!important;padding:0 2px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap2,11.5px)!important;",
                "line-height:1.6!important;color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;letter-spacing:.01em!important;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-row input,.csh-dbg-row select{display:block!important;width:100%!important;padding:10px 12px!important;border-radius:8px!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.12)!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md,13px)!important;",
                "font-family:inherit!important;position:static!important;outline:none!important;transition:border-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-row input::placeholder{color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-row input:focus,.csh-dbg-row select:focus{border-color:var(--csh-blue)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--csh-blue-rgb),.14)!important;}",
                /* ---------- 技能列表 ---------- */
                /* 【2026-09-30 空间修复】去掉 max-height:44vh —— 它把技能列表锁死在 371px，
                   而外层 #csh-dbg-body 本来就在滚，于是形成「双层滚动」且一次少显示约 2.4 行
                   （实测浪费约 31% 可视高度）。改为不限高、列表随内容撑开，滚动统一交给 body。 */
                "#csh-dbg-skill-list{display:block!important;overflow:visible!important;width:100%!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.12)!important;border-radius:10px!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;margin-top:9px!important;",
                "box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.04),0 8px 20px -14px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.16)!important;}",
                "#csh-dbg-skill-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;}",
                "#csh-dbg-skill-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.16)!important;border-radius:999px!important;border:3px solid transparent!important;background-clip:content-box!important;}",
                /* 【2026-10-03 精炼】列表**空**时不留空壳框：一个 100px 高的空盒子 + 一行提示
                   就是纯噪音。空态由 .csh-dbg-empty 一行文字表达，框与底全部撤掉。 */
                "#csh-dbg-skill-list.is-empty{border:none!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;margin-top:6px!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk{display:table!important;width:100%!important;table-layout:fixed!important;border-collapse:collapse!important;position:static!important;",
                "min-height:48px!important;cursor:pointer!important;",
                "border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.06)!important;transition:background .15s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk:last-child{border-bottom:none!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk:hover{background:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.035)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--csh-blue)!important;outline-offset:-2px!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info{display:table-cell!important;vertical-align:middle!important;padding:10px 12px!important;width:auto!important;position:static!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info .n{display:block!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md2,13.5px)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;font-weight:600!important;position:static!important;letter-spacing:-.005em!important;",
                "overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info .id{display:block!important;margin-top:2px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap,11px)!important;color:var(--csh-gray)!important;position:static!important;",
                "font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Consolas,monospace!important;letter-spacing:.2px!important;",
                "overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}",
                /* 来源包 + 势力：同名技能消歧（§4.6.2），单行省略 */
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info .src{display:block!important;margin-top:3px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap,11px)!important;color:var(--csh-gray)!important;",
                "position:static!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info .src b{display:inline!important;position:static!important;font-weight:600!important;color:var(--csh-blue)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-info .src i{display:inline!important;position:static!important;font-style:normal!important;color:var(--csh-gray)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts{display:table-cell!important;vertical-align:middle!important;width:auto!important;text-align:right!important;",
                "padding:10px 12px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;position:static!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts button{display:inline-block!important;cursor:pointer!important;padding:6px 13px!important;margin-left:6px!important;",
                "border-radius:8px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-sm,12px)!important;font-weight:500!important;border:1px solid transparent!important;color:var(--csh-fg)!important;font-family:inherit!important;",
                "position:static!important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.10)!important;",
                "transition:filter .16s ease,transform .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts button:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 10px -4px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.28)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts button.add{color:var(--csh-color-ink)!important;background:var(--csh-blue)!important;border-color:var(--csh-blue)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts button.rm{color:var(--csh-color-ink)!important;background:var(--csh-red)!important;border-color:var(--csh-red)!important;}",
                /* 窄屏：操作列按钮更紧凑（宽度已自适应，内容为准） */
                "@media (max-width:520px){.csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts{padding:10px 8px!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-sk .csh-dbg-sk-acts button{padding:6px 9px!important;margin-left:4px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap2,11.5px)!important;}}",
                /* ---------- 技能详情层（§4.6.2）：同层替换，不弹窗套弹窗 ---------- */
                ".csh-dbg-detail{display:block!important;width:100%!important;padding:2px 2px 6px!important;position:static!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-back{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:6px!important;cursor:pointer!important;",
                "min-height:40px!important;padding:6px 14px!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;border-radius:999px!important;",
                "font-size:var(--csh-lfs-sm2,12.5px)!important;font-weight:500!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;background:var(--csh-fg)!important;",
                "border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.12)!important;font-family:inherit!important;position:static!important;",
                "box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.03)!important;",
                "transition:border-color .16s ease,background .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease,transform .16s ease!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-back:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.22)!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;background:var(--csh-paper2)!important;transform:translateY(-1px)!important;}",
                /* ① 技能名（§4.6.2） */
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-name{display:block!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-xl2,17px)!important;font-weight:600!important;line-height:1.4!important;",
                "color:var(--csh-bg)!important;position:static!important;letter-spacing:-.01em!important;}",
                /* ② 标签行：ID / 来源包 / 势力 */
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-tags{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;gap:6px 8px!important;margin:10px 0 0!important;",
                "position:static!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-tag{display:inline-block!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;padding:3px 10px!important;border-radius:999px!important;",
                "font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap2,11.5px)!important;font-weight:500!important;line-height:1.5!important;color:var(--csh-gray)!important;position:static!important;",
                "background:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.045)!important;border:1px solid transparent!important;",
                "max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important;white-space:nowrap!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-tag.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono','SF Mono',Consolas,monospace!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-tag.k-src{color:var(--csh-blue)!important;border-color:transparent!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-blue-rgb),.10)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-tag.k-camp{color:var(--csh-gray)!important;border-color:transparent!important;background:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.055)!important;}",
                /* ③ 正文块 / 行高 1.7 / max-width:64ch */
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-body{display:block!important;margin:16px 0 0!important;padding:15px 17px!important;",
                "border-radius:10px!important;background:var(--csh-light)!important;border:1px solid rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.06)!important;",
                "border-left:3px solid var(--csh-accent)!important;",
                "font-size:var(--csh-lfs-md2,13.5px)!important;line-height:1.75!important;color:var(--csh-bg)!important;position:static!important;",
                "max-width:64ch!important;white-space:pre-wrap!important;word-break:break-word!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-body.none{color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;font-style:normal!important;border-left-color:rgba(var(--csh-bg-rgb),.14)!important;}",
                ".csh-dbg-detail .csh-dbg-dt-h{display:block!important;margin:20px 0 9px!important;font-size:var(--csh-lfs-cap2,11.5px)!important;font-weight:600!important;",
                "color:var(--csh-gray-soft)!important;letter-spacing:.09em!important;position:static!important;}",

			meChars: meta.meChars || [],
			seatCount: meta.seatCount || 0,
			/* 回合与出牌 */
			turn: 0, cardsTurn: 0, cardsTurnMax: 0, cardsTotal: 0,
			handAtWin: -1, handMin: 99, lastHandPrev: null,
			emptyHandTurns: 0, emptyHandTurnsMax: 0,
			handUp: 0, handUpMax: 0, lastHandEnd: -1,
			/* 伤害与击破 */
			dmgMax: 0, dmgTurn: 0, dmgTurnMax: 0,
			hurt: 0, hpMax: 0, hpNow: 0, hpMin: 99, nearDeath: 0,
			kills: 0, killsTurn: 0, killsTurnMax: 0, killTurnsInRow: 0, killTurnsInRowMax: 0,
			killByRole: {}, killTurns: {},
			dmgTurnsInRow: 0, dmgTurnsInRowMax: 0, dmgTurns: {},
			/* 技能 */
			skillTurn: 0, skillTurnMax: 0, skillChain: 0, skillChainMax: 0,
			skillUseCount: {}, skillUsedAll: false,
			/* 闪避与判定 */
			dodgeStreak: 0, dodgeStreakMax: 0,
			judgeHit: 0, judgeTotal: 0,
			/* 局面 */
			playsBySeat: {}, played: {},
			allyDead: false, allyGap: 0, foeFullHpSeen: false,
			isLandlord: null, farmerPlays: 0, landlordPlays: 0,
			/* 跨局累计（由宿主在 over 前注入） */
			charWins: 0, distinctWins: 0,
			/* 本局新解锁 */
			unlocked: [],
		};
	}

	function bumpTurn(a) {
		/* 回合边界：把"本回合量"结算进 Max，再清零 */
		if (a.cardsTurn > a.cardsTurnMax) a.cardsTurnMax = a.cardsTurn;
		if (a.dmgTurn > a.dmgTurnMax) a.dmgTurnMax = a.dmgTurn;
		if (a.skillTurn > a.skillTurnMax) a.skillTurnMax = a.skillTurn;
		if (a.killsTurn > a.killsTurnMax) a.killsTurnMax = a.killsTurn;
		if (a.emptyHandTurns > a.emptyHandTurnsMax) a.emptyHandTurnsMax = a.emptyHandTurns;
		if (a.handUp > a.handUpMax) a.handUpMax = a.handUp;
		/* 连续回合类：本回合有没有发生 */
		if (a.killsTurn > 0) a.killTurnsInRow++; else a.killTurnsInRow = 0;
		if (a.killTurnsInRow > a.killTurnsInRowMax) a.killTurnsInRowMax = a.killTurnsInRow;
		if (a.dmgTurn > 0) a.dmgTurnsInRow++; else a.dmgTurnsInRow = 0;
		if (a.dmgTurnsInRow > a.dmgTurnsInRowMax) a.dmgTurnsInRowMax = a.dmgTurnsInRow;
		if (a.skillTurn > 0) a.skillChain++; else a.skillChain = 0;
		if (a.skillChain > a.skillChainMax) a.skillChainMax = a.skillChain;
		a.cardsTurn = 0; a.dmgTurn = 0; a.skillTurn = 0; a.killsTurn = 0;
		a.emptyHandTurns = 0; a.handUp = 0;
		a.turn++;
	}

	/* ============================================================
	   3. 事件喂入（只累加，不判定）
	   ------------------------------------------------------------
	   ev 是**归一化后**的事件，宿主负责把引擎事件翻译成这个形状：
	     { t:"turn",  seat }                                    我的回合开始
	     { t:"useCard", seat, name, targets, handAfter, before }
	     { t:"useSkill", seat, skill }
	     { t:"damage", seat, victimSeat, num, bySkill }
	     { t:"die", seat, victimSeat, bySkill, victimRole }
	     { t:"judge", seat, hit }
	     { t:"hp", seat, hp, maxHp }
	     { t:"over", win, turns, survivors, ident, landlordSeat }
	   ============================================================ */
	function feed(a, ev) {
		if (!a || !ev) return;
		switch (ev.t) {
			case "turn":
				/* 【2026-10-20 修】原来只在"我的回合"才推进 ⇒ a.turn 实际是"我行动过几次"，
				   一局通常 5~10 次，「打满 20 回合」永远达不成。回合是全场节拍，谁开始都算。 */
				bumpTurn(a);
				break;
			case "useCard":
				if (ev.seat === a.meSeat) {
					a.cardsTurn++;
					a.cardsTotal = (a.cardsTotal || 0) + 1;
					a.played[ev.name] = 1;
					if (typeof ev.handAfter === "number") {
						a.lastHandEnd = ev.handAfter;
						if (ev.handAfter < a.handMin) a.handMin = ev.handAfter;
						if (ev.handAfter === 0) a.emptyHandTurns++;
						if (a.lastHandPrev != null && ev.handAfter > a.lastHandPrev) a.handUp++;
						a.lastHandPrev = ev.handAfter;
					}
				}
				a.playsBySeat[ev.seat] = (a.playsBySeat[ev.seat] || 0) + 1;
				break;
			case "useSkill":
				if (ev.seat === a.meSeat) {
					a.skillTurn++;
					a.skillUseCount[ev.skill] = (a.skillUseCount[ev.skill] || 0) + 1;
				}
				break;
			case "damage":
				if (ev.victimSeat === a.meSeat) {
					a.hurt += ev.num || 0;
					var left = a.hpNow - (ev.num || 0);
					if (left <= 0 && a.hpNow > 0) a.nearDeath++;
				}
				if (ev.seat === a.meSeat) {
					a.dmgTurn += ev.num || 0;
					if ((ev.num || 0) > a.dmgMax) a.dmgMax = ev.num;
				}
				/* 记下"这一下是不是技能造成的"，供「收网」在 die 时回读 */
				if (!a.lastDmgBySkill) a.lastDmgBySkill = {};
				a.lastDmgBySkill[ev.victimSeat] = !!ev.bySkill;
				break;
			case "die":
				if (ev.seat === a.meSeat && ev.victimSeat !== a.meSeat) {
					a.kills++;
					a.killsTurn++;
					if (ev.victimRole) a.killByRole[ev.victimRole] = (a.killByRole[ev.victimRole] || 0) + 1;
				}
				break;
			case "judge":
				a.judgeTotal++;
				if (ev.hit) a.judgeHit++;
				break;
			case "hp":
				if (ev.seat === a.meSeat) {
					a.hpNow = ev.hp;
					if (ev.maxHp && (!a.hpMax || ev.maxHp > a.hpMax)) a.hpMax = ev.maxHp;
					if (ev.hp < a.hpMin) a.hpMin = ev.hp;
					if (ev.hp === 0 && a.hpMin > 0) a.nearDeath++;
				}
				break;
			default:
				break;
		}
	}

	/* ============================================================
	   4. 判定（只跑与本事件相关的规则）
	   ============================================================ */
	function judge(a, ev, modes) {
		var out = [];
		/* 模式白名单在判定层再挡一次：万一将来有人绕过 install 直接调 judge，
		   也不能让国战/联机之类的对局写进池子成就。 */
		if (!a || !MODES[a.mode]) return out;
		var list = INDEX[ev.t];
		if (!list) return out;
		if (ev.t === "over") finalize(a, ev);
		for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
			var r = list[i];
			if (r.modes && r.modes.length && r.modes.indexOf(a.mode) < 0) continue;
			if (a.unlocked.indexOf(r.id) >= 0) continue;       /* 本局已解锁，不重复 */
			var ok = false;
			try { ok = !!r.test(ev, a); } catch (e) { ok = false; }
			if (ok) out.push(r);
		}
		return out;
	}

	/* 结算前把派生量算出来（都是纯算术，无副作用） */
	function finalize(a, ev) {
		a.survivors = ev.survivors == null ? 0 : ev.survivors;
		/* 优先用引擎给的真实手牌数；拿不到才回落到"最后一次出牌后"的记录 */
		a.handAtWin = (ev.hand != null) ? ev.hand : a.lastHandEnd;
		if (ev.ident) {
			var landlord = ev.landlordSeat;
			a.isLandlord = (landlord == null) ? null : (landlord === a.meSeat);
			a.farmerPlays = 0; a.landlordPlays = 0;
			for (var s in a.playsBySeat) {
				var seat = Number(s);
				if (seat === landlord) a.landlordPlays += a.playsBySeat[s];
				else a.farmerPlays += a.playsBySeat[s];
			}
		}
		/* 反贼总数：身份场固定 4 反（人数少时按实际） */
		a.fanTotal = 0;
		if (ev.ident) for (var sid in ev.ident) if (ev.ident[sid] === "fan") a.fanTotal++;
	}

	/* ============================================================
	   5. 存档（localStorage；只在解锁时写）
	   ============================================================ */
	var memStore = null;
	function load() {
		try {
			if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return memStore || (memStore = { v: VER, got: {}, seen: {}, chars: {} });
			var raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
			if (!raw) return { v: VER, got: {}, seen: {}, chars: {} };
			var o = JSON.parse(raw);
			if (!o || typeof o !== "object") return { v: VER, got: {}, seen: {}, chars: {} };
			o.got = o.got || {}; o.seen = o.seen || {}; o.chars = o.chars || {};
			return o;
		} catch (e) { return { v: VER, got: {}, seen: {}, chars: {} }; }
	}
	function save(o) {
		memStore = o;
		try {
			if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
		} catch (e) {}
	}
	function unlock(id, mode) {
		var o = load();
		var now = Date.now();
		if (o.got[id]) { o.got[id].n = (o.got[id].n || 1) + 1; }
		else { o.got[id] = { t: now, m: mode || "", n: 1 }; }
		save(o);
		return o.got[id];
	}
	function claimState() {
		var o = load();
		var got = 0, seen = 0, byRare = { 1: 0, 2: 0, 3: 0 };
		for (var i = 0; i < RULES.length; i++) {
			var id = RULES[i].id;
			if (o.got[id]) { got++; byRare[RULES[i].rare]++; if (o.seen[id]) seen++; }
		}
		return { got: got, total: RULES.length, seen: seen, byRare: byRare, unread: got - seen };
	}

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------
	   5b. 发奖对账（2026-10-20 · 防重复领取）
	   ------------------------------------------------------------
	   漏洞：成就页「重新开始」或单清 csh_pool_achv 会把 seen 抹掉，
	   已领过的奖励就能再领一遍（CBY/功勋无限刷）。
	   三层防线，任一命中即视为「已付」——只补 seen，不发钱：
	     ① 主存档 seen（原逻辑）；
	     ② 独立发奖台账 csh_pool_achv_pay：只增不删，页面级重置不清它。
	        （save.html 的「全部重置」会连同钱包/流水一起清——
	         那种情况经济已归零，重领不算刷，语义一致）；
	     ③ 钱包流水反推：扫 CSH.wallet.ledger 里 reason="池子成就/<名>"
	        的入账记录——台账也被误删时的兜底。
	   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
	var K_PAY = "csh_pool_achv_pay";
	var memPay = null;
	function loadPay() {
		try {
			if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return memPay || (memPay = { v: 1, paid: {} });
			var raw = localStorage.getItem(K_PAY);
			if (!raw) return { v: 1, paid: {} };
			var o = JSON.parse(raw);
			if (!o || typeof o !== "object" || !o.paid || typeof o.paid !== "object") return { v: 1, paid: {} };
			return o;
		} catch (e) { return { v: 1, paid: {} }; }
	}
	function savePay(o) {
		memPay = o;
		try {
			if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(K_PAY, JSON.stringify(o));
		} catch (e) {}
	}
	var _ruleNameMap = null;
	function ruleName(id) {
		if (!_ruleNameMap) {
			_ruleNameMap = {};
			for (var i = 0; i < RULES.length; i++) _ruleNameMap[RULES[i].id] = RULES[i].name;
		}
		return _ruleNameMap[id] || "";
	}
	/* 钱包流水里的「池子成就/<名>」入账 → 已付名单（结果缓存，recordPaid 后失效重扫） */
	var _walletPaidCache = null;
	function walletPaidNames() {
		if (_walletPaidCache) return _walletPaidCache;
		var names = {};
		try {
			var W = root.CSH && root.CSH.wallet;
			if (W && typeof W.ledger === "function") {
				var list = W.ledger({ kind: "in" });
				for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
					var r = String(list[i].r || "");
					if (r.indexOf("池子成就/") === 0) names[r.slice(5)] = 1;
				}
			}
		} catch (e) {}
		_walletPaidCache = names;
		return names;
	}
	/* 领取闸门：true=已付过（调用方补 seen、不发钱）；false=可以发钱 */
	function isPaid(id) {
		var o = load();
		if (o.seen[id]) return true;
		var p = loadPay();
		if (p.paid[id]) return true;
		var nm = ruleName(id);
		if (nm && walletPaidNames()[nm]) return true;
		return false;
	}
	/* 发钱成功后记账：写台账 + 补 seen + 流水缓存失效（下次重扫） */
	function recordPaid(id, pc, merit) {
		var p = loadPay();
		if (!p.paid[id]) {
			p.paid[id] = { t: Date.now(), pc: Math.floor(Number(pc) || 0), merit: Math.floor(Number(merit) || 0) };
			savePay(p);
		}
		var o = load();
		if (o.got[id] && !o.seen[id]) { o.seen[id] = 1; save(o); }
		_walletPaidCache = null;
	}
	/* 对账自愈：台账/流水显示已付、但 seen 丢了的，补回 seen（不发钱）。
	   成就页加载时跑一次。返回补回条数。 */
	function reconcile() {
		var o = load(), p = loadPay(), wn = null, n = 0;
		for (var i = 0; i < RULES.length; i++) {
			var id = RULES[i].id;
			if (!o.got[id] || o.seen[id]) continue;
			if (!p.paid[id]) {
				if (wn === null) wn = walletPaidNames();
				if (!wn[ruleName(id)]) continue;
			}
			o.seen[id] = 1; n++;
		}
		if (n) save(o);
		return n;
	}

	/* ============================================================
	   6. 引擎适配层（唯一耦合点）
	   ------------------------------------------------------------
	   host 由调用方注入，避免本文件 import 任何东西：
	     { game, lib, getMode(), getMe(), toast(), grant(rewards), log() }
	   宁可这层保守一点，也不要让成就去猜引擎细节。
	   ============================================================ */
	function install(host) {
		try {
			if (!host || !host.game || !host.lib) return false;
			var game = host.game, lib = host.lib;
			if (lib.__cshPoolAchvInstalled) return true;
			lib.__cshPoolAchvInstalled = true;

			var run = null;
			function mode() {
				try { return String((lib.config && lib.config.mode) || ""); } catch (e) { return ""; }
			}
			function allowed() {
				/* 联机 / 旁观 / 调试局 / 导入过程 一律不计 */
				try {
					if (lib.config && lib.config.connectMode) return false;
					if (lib.config && lib.config.dev) return false;
					if (typeof _status !== "undefined" && (_status.importingExtension || _status.videoInited)) return false;
					if (typeof game !== "undefined" && game.observe) return false;
				} catch (e) {}
				return true;
			}
			function active() {
				return run && allowed() && MODES[run.mode] === 1;
			}

			/* 事件翻译：引擎 → 归一化事件（拿不准的字段一律给安全默认值） */
			function onGameStart() {
				var m = mode();
				if (!MODES[m] || !allowed()) { run = null; return; }
				var me = null;
				try { me = game.me || (game.players && game.players[0]); } catch (e) {}
				run = newRun({
					mode: m,
					meSeat: me && typeof me.seatNum === "number" ? me.seatNum : -1,
					meIdentity: (me && me.identity) || "",
					meChars: me && me.name ? [String(me.name)] : [],
					seatCount: (game.players && game.players.length) || 0,
				});
				try {
					run.hpNow = me ? me.hp : 0;
					run.hpMax = me ? me.maxHp : 0;
					run.hpMin = me ? me.hp : 99;
				} catch (e2) {}
			}
			function seatOf(p) {
				try { return p && typeof p.seatNum === "number" ? p.seatNum : -1; } catch (e) { return -1; }
			}
			function pump(ev) {
				if (!active()) return;
				feed(run, ev);
				var hit = judge(run, ev);
				if (!hit.length) return;
				for (var i = 0; i < hit.length; i++) {
					run.unlocked.push(hit[i].id);
					unlock(hit[i].id, run.mode);
				}
				try { host.onUnlock && host.onUnlock(hit, run); } catch (e) {}
			}

			/* 全局技：只挂白名单里的引擎事件，全部 silent，不影响牌局 */
			var SKILL = "csh_pool_achv_tap";
			lib.skill[SKILL] = {
				trigger: {
					global: ["gameStart"],
					player: ["phaseUseBegin", "useCard", "useSkill", "damageEnd", "die", "judgeEnd", "changeHp"],
				},
				forced: true,
				silent: true,
				popup: false,
				priority: 100,
				filter: function () { return active(); },
				content: function () {
					try {
						var t = trigger.name;
						if (t === "gameStart") { onGameStart(); return; }
						if (t === "phaseUseBegin") { pump({ t: "turn", seat: seatOf(player) }); return; }
						if (t === "useCard") {
							pump({
								t: "useCard", seat: seatOf(player), name: trigger.card && trigger.card.name,
								targets: (trigger.targets && trigger.targets.length) || 0,
								handAfter: player ? player.countCards("h") : 0,
								before: (trigger.card && trigger.card.cards && trigger.card.cards.length) || 0,
							});
							return;
						}
						if (t === "useSkill") { pump({ t: "useSkill", seat: seatOf(player), skill: trigger.skill }); return; }
						if (t === "damageEnd") {
							pump({
								t: "damage", seat: seatOf(trigger.source), victimSeat: seatOf(player),
								num: trigger.num || 0, bySkill: !!trigger.skill,
							});
							return;
						}
						if (t === "die") {
							/* die 事件的 player 是**死者**，击杀者要从 trigger.source 取；
							   引擎没给 source 时（毒/判定致死等）不记在任何人头上。 */
							pump({
								t: "die", seat: seatOf(trigger.source), victimSeat: seatOf(player),
								bySkill: false, victimRole: (player && player.identity) || "",
							});
							return;
						}
						if (t === "judgeEnd") { pump({ t: "judge", seat: seatOf(player), hit: !!trigger.result }); return; }
						if (t === "changeHp") {
							pump({ t: "hp", seat: seatOf(player), hp: player.hp, maxHp: player.maxHp });
							return;
						}
					} catch (e) { try { host.log && host.log("feed 异常：" + e); } catch (e2) {} }
				},
			};
			if (game.addGlobalSkill) game.addGlobalSkill(SKILL);

			/* 结算：包 game.over（与 csh_bossrecord 同一先例）。
			   ★ 包装体里不引用闭包变量，防联机序列化带走 —— 所以先取局部引用。 */
			var orig = game.over;
			if (typeof orig === "function" && !orig.__cshPoolAchv) {
				var wrapped = function () {
					try { window.__cshPoolAchvOver && window.__cshPoolAchvOver(arguments[0]); } catch (e) {}
					return orig.apply(this, arguments);
				};
				wrapped.__cshPoolAchv = true;
				game.over = wrapped;
			}
			root.__cshPoolAchvOver = function (winner) {
				try {
					if (!active()) return;
					var me = game.me || {};
					/* 胜负口径：以 game.over(winner) 的实参为准（true / 玩家对象 / 玩家数组）。
					   拿不准就算"没赢"——宁可漏记一条成就，也不给错的。 */
					var win = false;
					try {
						if (winner === true) win = true;
						else if (Array.isArray(winner)) win = winner.indexOf(me) >= 0;
						else if (winner === me) win = true;
					} catch (eW) { win = false; }

					/* 跨局累计（本命 / 百将）：先读存档里的历史，再判本局，最后统一落盘。
					   ★ 用"判之前的值 + 本局"注入，避免"本局赢了但本命不吃这局"。 */
					var cross = { chars: 0, distinct: 0 };
					try {
						var st0 = load();
						var nm0 = (run.meChars && run.meChars[0]) || "";
						var prev0 = (st0.chars && st0.chars[nm0]) || 0;
						cross.chars = prev0 + (win ? 1 : 0);
						cross.distinct = Object.keys(st0.chars || {}).length + ((win && !prev0) ? 1 : 0);
					} catch (eC) {}
					run.charWins = cross.chars;
					run.distinctWins = cross.distinct;
					var ident = {};
					try {
						for (var i = 0; i < game.players.length; i++) ident[game.players[i].seatNum] = game.players[i].identity || "";
					} catch (e2) {}
					var landlord = null;
					try {
						if (run.mode === "doudizhu" && game.zhu) landlord = game.zhu.seatNum;
					} catch (e3) {}
					pump({
						t: "over", win: win, turns: run.turn,
						survivors: (game.players || []).filter(function (p) { try { return p.isAlive(); } catch (e) { return false; } }).length,
						ident: ident, landlordSeat: landlord,
						hand: (function () { try { return me.countCards("h"); } catch (eH) { return null; } })(),
					});
					/* 落盘跨局累计（只记胜场；赢了才 +1） */
					try {
						if (win) {
							var st1 = load();
							var nm1 = (run.meChars && run.meChars[0]) || "";
							if (nm1) {
								st1.chars = st1.chars || {};
								st1.chars[nm1] = (st1.chars[nm1] || 0) + 1;
								save(st1);
							}
						}
					} catch (eP) {}
					run = null;
				} catch (e) { try { host.log && host.log("over 异常：" + e); } catch (e2) {} }
			};
			return true;
		} catch (e) {
			try { host && host.log && host.log("install 失败：" + e); } catch (e2) {}
			return false;
		}
	}

	/* ============================================================
	   7. 自检（探针直接用；也供页面"成就系统自检"按钮）
	   ============================================================ */
	function selfTest() {
		var errs = [];
		var seen = {};
		for (var i = 0; i < RULES.length; i++) {
			var r = RULES[i];
			if (seen[r.id]) errs.push("重复 id：" + r.id);
			seen[r.id] = 1;
			if (["操作", "连击", "逆境", "模式", "武将"].indexOf(r.cat) < 0) errs.push(r.id + " 分类非法：" + r.cat);
			if ([1, 2, 3].indexOf(r.rare) < 0) errs.push(r.id + " 稀有度非法");
			if (!r.desc) errs.push(r.id + " 缺 desc");
			if (!r.on || !r.on.length) errs.push(r.id + " 缺 on");
			for (var j = 0; j < (r.on || []).length; j++) if (!_EVENTS[r.on[j]]) errs.push(r.id + " 事件越界：" + r.on[j]);
			if (typeof r.test !== "function") errs.push(r.id + " 缺 test");
			for (var m = 0; m < (r.modes || []).length; m++) if (!MODES[r.modes[m]]) errs.push(r.id + " 模式越界：" + r.modes[m]);
		}
		return { ok: errs.length === 0, errors: errs, total: RULES.length };
	}

	root.CSH_POOL_ACHV = {
		VER: VER, KEY: KEY, MODES: MODES, EVENTS: _EVENTS,
		RULES: RULES, INDEX: INDEX,
		newRun: newRun, feed: feed, judge: judge, install: install,
		load: load, save: save, unlock: unlock, claimState: claimState,
		PAY_KEY: K_PAY, isPaid: isPaid, recordPaid: recordPaid, reconcile: reconcile,
		selfTest: selfTest,
	};
}
